title: NIST WebBook: Naphthalene is C10H8, molecular weight 128.1705 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Naphthalene as C10H8, molecular weight 128.1705 amu, CAS 91-20-3.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Naphthalene, CAS Registry Number 91-20-3, lists molecular formula C10H8 and molecular weight 128.1705 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 128.0626003 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C10H8/c1-2-6-10-8-4-3-7-9(10)5-1/h1-8H. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
